youtube.title: Why Metal Feels Colder Than Wood 🥶 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A metal fork and a wooden spoon left in the same room are the same temperature, yet metal feels colder. Your skin does not sense an object's temperature. It senses how fast your own skin is losing heat. Metals have high thermal conductivity, so they pull heat out of your fingers far faster than wood, which is an insulator.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
